suites.description: Core generic accuracy suite.
Hard generalization and multi-hop suite.
Generalization and associative-query suite.
Noisy context and cross-entity dependency suite.
Extreme dependency and same-surface suite.
Stress and open-world suite.
Long-horizon drift and entity-scale suite.
Rule evolution suite covering history/current/supplement transitions and cross-entity governing artifacts.
Cross-format longform suite covering markdown, email, YAML-ish, bilingual, prose-checklist, and correction-note inputs.
Multi-subject long-document suite covering primary subject extraction, side-subject filtering, same-prefix artifact splitting, and single-document cross-entity reasoning.
Unknown-domain and unfamiliar-artifact suite.
Broader coverage suite for long docs, deeper associations, and larger same-scope mixes.
Far-field unfamiliar-domain suite with archive, herbarium, orbital, vessel, theater, and chart-manual scenarios.
Deeper multi-hop association, history, conflict, and external-requirement suite.
Heterogeneous mixed long-doc, same-surface, history-rule, and mixed-language suite.
Concurrent ingest consistency suite.
Ultra-long single-document multi-entity suite.
Format-shift suite covering email threads, YAML-ish records, tables, field records, and transcript-style inputs.
Captured real longform debate records for out-of-template generalization checks.
Stock-market flavored generic memory suite covering equity risk recall, same-surface note disambiguation, and market why-query chains.
Broader finance-domain suite covering ETF, sector note, portfolio review, macro calendar, cross-asset why queries, and noisy related gaps.
Cross-domain knowledge transfer suite covering analogous structures, role mappings, causality chains, hierarchy analogies, metric analogies, and procedure analogies.
Temporal reasoning suite covering sequence order, duration constraints, before/after updates, deadline reasoning, overlapping events, and cyclic patterns.
Negation and conflict handling suite covering explicit rejection, permission denial, update overrides, contradictory sources, double negatives, and conditional exceptions.
Numerical reasoning suite covering threshold comparisons, range interpretations, ratio proportions, trend directions, unit conversions, and priority rankings.
Implicit relation inference suite covering hierarchy inheritance, causality chains, role substitution, location containment, symmetric relations, and precondition inference.
Large-scope graph suite covering 12-20 entities per scope, same-prefix artifact splitting, cross-entity shared blockers, and ambiguity resilience.
Deeper dependency chain suite covering 5-6 hop requirement chains, direct blocker plus co-required items, history disagreement with external rules, and noisy deep chains.
Out-of-distribution domains suite covering shipping, archive, museum, geological survey, astronomical observatory, agriculture, public safety, and mixed-language laboratory scenarios.
Identity-boundary suite covering same-prefix artifacts, role-vs-document separation, team-vs-manual dependencies, and explicit alias surface forms.
Answer-boundary suite covering direct-vs-dependency answers, related background suppression, multi-subject parallel answers, and noisy direct-answer scope.
Semantic-paraphrase suite covering non-literal recall queries, missing-record wording, artifact defects, and dependency questions without exact source phrasing.
State-transition boundary suite covering current-vs-history blockers, additive supplements, explicit corrections, and historical allowance vs current gate changes.
Real-world daily memory suite covering school forms, apartment maintenance, pet appointments, and neighborhood package pickup with ordinary distractors.
Real-world complex memory suite covering renovation dependencies, family care schedules, multi-person travel documents, and event correction/vendor separation.
Real-world work operations suite covering customer onboarding, hiring loops, procurement, contract redlines, and training/deck review boundaries.
Real-world software development suite covering API contracts, CI failures, database migrations, feature rollouts, and PR/release-note boundaries.
Real-world edge cases for shared names, gaps, dependencies, archives, exceptions, and corrections.
Real-world adversarial cases for aliases, table tickets, final decisions, negation, and noise.
